info.title: Fenergo Nebula Configuration Exchange Query
info.description:
**Configuration Exchange Query API provides**:
  • Import Session Models retrieval
  • Import Session Models retrieval
  • Import history summary retrieval

sourceEquivalentIdentifierSnapshot.description:
Source-side equivalence identifier captured by the UI at the time
of the prior successful import (sent as
`ImportItem.EquivalentIdentifierSnapshot` on the close-phase
command). This is the value the UI equivalence finder will compare
against the target configuration's `equivalentIdentifier` on
subsequent imports, and is intentionally distinct from the display
name — for some config types they coincide (e.g. Teams,
Risk threshold model active name), for others they diverge
(e.g. ComponentLibrary where the identifier is the configType
constant, IntegrationFlowsLibraries where it is the libraryKey).
May be `null` for backfilled rows or events from older UI
clients that did not send the field.
Source-side equivalent identifier snapshot stored when the import succeeded.
